column1: # library: a directory of macro files, "@file" for one file (composed alone), or "-" when the model defines its macros itself.
# Not listed yet: libsets/diff-patch. The native parser now reads its queries, but its rules spell variables as typed names
# (patchset:?ps), which both frontends read as a literal node, so they never fire on real data. The library needs a redesign.
